contests.title: City of Salida — Publishing Ordinances by Title

provenance.quote: Shall the City of Salida publish ordinances by title only rather than by publishing ordinances in full to satisfy the ordinance publication requirements in Colorado Revised Statutes 31-16-105 and 31-16-106?

measureRecords.yesMeans: Allow the city to publish ordinances by title only for these legal publication requirements.
measureRecords.noMeans: Keep the full-text publication requirement described in the question.
